Elena Ruiz — Human Factors & Single-Operator Safety said about it: I take from Push or Pull on an Object: Physics Theory, Ergonomics, and 2026 Best Practices - Push or pull on an object (E53, Push or Pull on an Object: Physics Theory, Ergonomics, and 2026 Best Practices - Push or pull on an object) that ISO 11228-2, meaning International Organization for Standardization push-pull standard, recommends under 200 N horizontal sustained, and I take from GSO ISO 11228-2:2015 (E54, GSO ISO 11228-2:2015) that sustained force means force to keep an object at constant velocity.
